assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of an unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9).
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic causes.
The diagnosis code I49.9 is used for unspecified cardiac arrhythmia.
The diagnosis code R42 is used for dizziness and giddiness.
The diagnosis code Z86.73 is used for personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
The CPT code for mobile cardiac telemetry is 93229.
